roles.purpose: 呈现证据来源、形成过程及局限
组织已有概念关系；不增写机制
呈现实际观察、数据与不确定性
比较同一维度下的对象
说明实施条件、操作或限制
呈现已授权的时间或阶段次序
总结要点、边界和结束信息
提供补充细节、原图或来源索引

primary_role_rule: Exactly one primary role per slide. Secondary content tags are descriptive only. Cover/content legacy labels do not determine scientific semantics. Coverage means N of N slides assigned, not all ten roles used.
mixed_role_rule: Choose dominant communicative purpose and record rationale. A closing page may retain an appendix source-content tag. Role mapping must not split or add scientific content.
exception_rule: Not approved selector defaults. Retained existing layout only, explicit reason, rejected alternatives, evidence locator and human review. Unknown role or no safe compatible family produces HOLD_EXISTING/INFORMATION_REQUIRED, never invented semantics.
